task_summary: Count unique pedestrians in surveillance videos using VLM APIs and write results to an Excel file
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct concerns: (1) video frame extraction and encoding, (2) VLM-based pedestrian counting with de-duplication logic, and (3) Excel output formatting. However, since the VLM inference is tightly coupled with the frame preparation and the Excel output is simple, a 2-skill decomposition cleanly separates video/image processing from the VLM analysis + reporting pipeline.

skills.name: evo-video-frame-extraction
skills.description: Extracts and encodes sampled frames from video files using MoviePy 2.1.2. Handles file discovery, temporal sampling, base64 JPEG encoding, and proper resource cleanup to prevent memory leaks.
skills.responsibility: Video file discovery, frame extraction at configurable intervals, NumPy-to-base64-JPEG conversion, and MoviePy resource management

skills.name: evo-pedestrian-vlm-counting
skills.description: Sends extracted video frames to Vision LLM APIs (OpenAI GPT-4o or Google Gemini) with carefully engineered prompts for unique pedestrian counting, parses integer results robustly, and writes final counts to a properly formatted Excel file.
skills.responsibility: VLM API integration (OpenAI and Gemini), prompt engineering for unique pedestrian re-identification, response parsing with integer coercion, and Excel output generation with correct sheet/column structure
